98 class PdfSession:
99     def __init__(self, path: str, password: str = ''):
100         self.path = str(Path(path).resolve())
101         self._source_version = file_version(self.path)
102         self._password = password
103         self.doc = fitz.open(self.path)
104         try:
105             self.encrypted, self.readonly, self.copy_allowed = access(self.doc, password)
106         except Exception:
107             self.doc.close()
108             raise
109         if not self.doc.is_pdf or self.doc.page_count == 0:
110             self.doc.close()
111             raise ValueError('Open a PDF containing at least one page.')
112         # Keep an isolated, normalized working file. Undo stores only incremental
113         # suffixes on disk, rather than copying every page for every mouse stroke.
114         # MuPDF's in-memory journal currently conflicts with font insertion and
115         # rotated-page text extraction, so edits use PDF incremental revisions.
116         self._temporary = tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix='paperlight-edit-')
117         self._working = Path(self._temporary.name) / 'working.pdf'
118         if self.encrypted:
119             # Keep the original security dictionary and both passwords, including
120             # passwords unknown to this session. Native encrypted incremental
121             # revisions allow Save to preserve that protection exactly.
122             self.doc.save(self._working,encryption=fitz.PDF_ENCRYPT_KEEP)
123         else:
124             self.doc.save(self._working, encryption=fitz.PDF_ENCRYPT_NONE)
125         self.doc.close()
126         self._open_working()
127         self._history = []
128         self._position = 0
129         self._revision = 0
130         self.saved_position = 0
131         self.redaction_applied = False
132         self._pending_count = None

209 def _pattern(template):
210     pieces=re.split(r'(\{\d+\})',template)
211     seen=set()
212     regex=''
213     for part in pieces:
214         if re.fullmatch(r'\{\d+\}',part):
215             name='p'+part[1:-1]
216             regex+=f'(?P={name})' if name in seen else f'(?P<{name}>.*?)'
217             seen.add(name)
218         else:
219             regex+=re.escape(part)
220     return re.compile(regex,re.S)

38 def access(doc, password=''):
39     """Return original security before normalizing the session's working file."""
40     # MuPDF's needs_pass probes an empty password. Read it BEFORE authentication:
41     # probing it afterwards can replace the active AES key and corrupt reads.
42     needs_password = doc.needs_pass
43     authentication = doc.authenticate(password)
44     if needs_password and not authentication:
45         raise ValueError('This PDF needs the correct password.')
46     encrypted = bool(doc.metadata and doc.metadata.get('encryption'))
47     owner = bool(authentication & 4)
48     readonly = encrypted and not owner and (doc.permissions & EDIT_PERMISSIONS != EDIT_PERMISSIONS)
49     copy_allowed = not encrypted or owner or bool(doc.permissions & fitz.PDF_PERM_COPY)
50     return encrypted, readonly, copy_allowed

46 def index_document(path, cache_root, language='eng+chi_sim+chi_tra', password='', ocr=True, seed=None):
47     started = time.perf_counter()
48     key = cache_key(path, language)
49     folder = Path(cache_root) / key
50     folder.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
51     emit(dict(kind='meta', key=key))
52     with fitz.open(path) as doc:
53         if doc.needs_pass and not doc.authenticate(password):
54             raise ValueError('Incorrect PDF password.')
55         # Publish native text for ALL pages before doing any expensive OCR.
56         pending = []
57         records = {}
58         for n, page in enumerate(doc):
59             cached = folder / f'{n}.json'
60             if seed and str(n) in seed and not cached.exists():
61                 store(cached, seed[str(n)])
62             if cached.exists():
63                 try:
64                     row = json.loads(cached.read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
65                     records[n] = row
66                     emit(dict(kind='page', **row, cached=True))
67                     if ocr and not row.get('complete', False):
68                         pending.append(n)
69                     continue
70                 except (ValueError, OSError):
71                     pass
72             row = dict(page=n, words=word_rows(page), complete=not needs_ocr(page), ocr=False)
73             records[n] = row
74             emit(dict(kind='page', **row, cached=False))
75             store(cached, row)
76             if not row['complete']:
77                 pending.append(n)
78         emit(dict(kind='native_done', pages=len(doc), pending=len(pending)))
79         failures = []
80         if ocr:
81             for position, n in enumerate(pending):
82                 emit(dict(kind='progress', page=n, current=position + 1, total=len(pending)))
83                 page = doc[n]
84                 try:
85                     tp = page.get_textpage_ocr(language=language, dpi=160, full=True,
86                                                tessdata=str(resource_path()))
87                     native = records[n]['words']
88                     native_rects = [fitz.Rect(w['rect']) for w in native]
89                     recognized = []
90                     for w in word_rows(page, tp, source='ocr'):
91                         rect = fitz.Rect(w['rect'])
92                         if not any((rect & r).get_area() > rect.get_area() * .45 for r in native_rects):
93                             recognized.append(w)
94                     row = dict(page=n, words=native + recognized, complete=True, ocr=True)
95                     store(folder / f'{n}.json', row)
96                     emit(dict(kind='page', **row, cached=False))
97                 except Exception as exc:
98                     failures.append(n)
99                     emit(dict(kind='warning', page=n, message=str(exc)))
100         emit(dict(kind='done', seconds=round(time.perf_counter()-started, 3),
101                   pages=len(doc), failures=failures, pending=0 if ocr else len(pending)))
